protocol: Three measured verbose runs of each revision per dataset, alternating before/after order; one unmeasured verbose warmup of each revision. Four workers, one BLAS thread. Existing benchmark.run_once pipeline/data-step timing and canonical RAM collector. TIFF hashing outside timers. Warm local source and OS caches; source backend is specified separately. Bounded real-data subset, not full historical campaign.

memory.method: smaps_rollup Pss - Pss_Shmem + managed segment mincore
memory.scope: backend parent and observed descendants; sampler excluded; overlapping jobs not isolated
